items.title: File Einspruch against fine notice
items.quote: Er muss zwei Wochen nach der Zustellung bei der Stadt Musterwilhelmshaven – Bußgeldstelle vorliegen, schriftlich oder zur Niederschrift.
items.computation: The letter was formally served (Zustellungsurkunde). The envelope copy shows the delivery mark 'zugest. am 23.11.2026' (a Monday) — for formal delivery the date written on the envelope is the delivery day, no days are added. Per § 67 OWiG / § 43 StPO, the Einspruch period is two weeks from delivery; the delivery day itself is not counted (§ 187 Abs. 1 BGB). Two weeks later on the same weekday (a Monday) gives 07.12.2026. 07.12.2026 is a normal Monday, not a weekend or public holiday in Niedersachsen, so no shift under § 43 Abs. 2 StPO is needed. The Einspruch must reach the Bußgeldstelle by this date.

items.title: Pay the total fine (Geldbuße, fee and delivery costs)
items.quote: Fällig wird der Betrag zwei Wochen, nachdem der Bescheid rechtskräftig geworden ist.
items.computation: Due date depends on when the notice becomes final (rechtskräftig). Assuming no Einspruch is filed, the notice becomes final the day after the Einspruch period ends, i.e. 08.12.2026 (a Tuesday), since the Einspruch deadline computed above is 07.12.2026. The payment falls due two weeks after that date; the day the notice becomes final is not counted (§ 187 Abs. 1 BGB analogy), so two weeks later on the same weekday (Tuesday) gives 22.12.2026. 22.12.2026 is a normal Tuesday, not a holiday in Niedersachsen, so no shift is needed. This date is only valid if no Einspruch is filed; filing an Einspruch would stop the notice from becoming final and this due date would no longer apply.

warnings: The payment due date (22.12.2026) is calculated from the fine notice becoming final, which only happens if no Einspruch is filed by 07.12.2026; if an Einspruch is filed, this payment deadline does not apply and should be disregarded.

The sender's email address domain ('stadt-musterwilhelmshaven-bu.example') uses the reserved '.example' top-level domain, which is unusual for a real municipal authority — double-check the authenticity of the contact details before using them.
